description: x402 rail: submit a signed EIP-3009 payment payload (X-PAYMENT). The facilitator verifies and broadcasts — the payer spends NO gas. DRY-RUN BY DEFAULT: shows the exact headers and body that WOULD be sent. Sign the authorization with buildX402Authorization() over the domain from acm_get_payment_requirements first. NOTE: x402 is live on Base mainnet (8453) when X402_ENABLED=1; it is paused elsewhere (Robinhood 4663 is wallet-only in v1), where this tool errors instead of sending.

dryRun.description: Default true: show, do not send.

payload.description: Full X-PAYMENT JSON payload (x402Version, accepted, payload.authorization+signature). The `accepted.network` pins the chain this payment settles on.

sellerProof.description: Circle keyless trial only: the payTo owner signs the seller proof (see docs/onboarding.md). Omitted otherwise.

name: acm_fund_x402_pay
